why: The arcs move clockwise around the box: top in A, right in B, bottom in C, left in D. At the same time the number of arcs grows by one: 1, 2, 3, 4. So C must have 3 arcs at the bottom, opening upwards: option 5. Option 3 is at the bottom but has only 2 arcs, and option 2 has 3 arcs but on the wrong side.
trick: Check two things together: where the shape goes (position) and how many there are (count).
note: Whole row A, B, ?, D drawn as one SVG because D comes after the ?.
